title: Inadequate Authentication
description: The student may not be using strong authentication methods, making it easier for unauthorized users to access their account and submit assignments on their behalf.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data such as student ID, course information, and submission timestamps may be intercepted during transmission if not properly encrypted.

title: Improper Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive student data insecurely, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The Grades Portal Web App may inadvertently share student data with third parties without proper consent.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The grades portal may inadvertently allow unauthorized users to access sensitive student information during the submission process, especially if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data transmitted between the grades portal and the assignment & grading service may be intercepted, leading to exposure of sensitive information such as student IDs and course details.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The assignment & grading service may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Unintended Data Retention
description: The assignment & grading service may retain student data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The grading service may inadvertently expose student data (ID, course, submission time) to unauthorized personnel during the assignment submission process.

title: Data Breach of Stored Assignments

title: Insecure Data Transmission
description: The data flow from the grading service to the assignment store may not be adequately secured, leading to interception of sensitive information during transmission.

title: Unauthorized Access to Teacher's Account
description: A malicious actor could gain access to the teacher's account if proper authentication measures are not in place, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Data Interception during Transmission
description: Data being transmitted from the teacher to the Grades Portal could be intercepted by an unauthorized party, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to data breaches or unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The portal may allow unauthorized users to access student submissions, including names and work content, due to insufficient access controls.

title: Insecure Data Handling by Teacher
description: The teacher may mishandle or improperly store the student data, leading to potential data leaks or unauthorized sharing.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Data transmitted from the portal to the teacher may be intercepted by malicious actors, exposing sensitive student information.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The teacher may retain student data longer than necessary, violating data retention policies and increasing the risk of data breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The teacher may not have obtained proper consent from the student to record and share their grades and feedback, leading to a potential violation of privacy rights.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades and Feedback
description: The Grades Portal Web App may not have adequate access controls, allowing unauthorized users to view sensitive information such as grades and feedback.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of grades and feedback from the teacher to the Grades Portal Web App, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades and feedback insecurely, making it vulnerable to data breaches and unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grading Service
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grading service and submit or modify grade records, leading to potential data breaches and integrity issues.

title: Insecure Storage of Grade Records
description: The grade records database may not have adequate security measures, leading to unauthorized access or data leaks.

title: Data in Transit Vulnerability
description: The data being transmitted from the grading service to the grade records database may be intercepted during transmission, exposing sensitive information.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The grade records may be retained longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: User Misunderstanding of Data Sharing
description: Users may not fully understand how their data is being used or shared, leading to potential privacy concerns.

title: Identity Theft
description: An attacker could impersonate the student to request grades and feedback, potentially gaining unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Data Breach
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades and feedback insecurely, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Non-repudiation Issues
description: The data flow may lack proper logging or authentication mechanisms, making it difficult to verify the identity of the requester and ensuring that the student cannot deny their request.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grades and feedback intended for a specific student due to insufficient access controls on the portal.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The student's grades and feedback may be stored insecurely on the student's device, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or interception.

title: Data Leakage through Metadata
description: Metadata associated with the data flow, such as timestamps or IP addresses, could potentially reveal information about the student's access patterns or identity.

title: Data Misuse by Student
description: The student may misuse the information received, such as sharing their grades or feedback with unauthorized individuals.

title: Unauthorized Access to Child's Grades
description: A parent may inadvertently share their login credentials with unauthorized individuals, allowing them to access their child's grades without permission.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades in an insecure manner, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted between the Parent and the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: A parent may gain unauthorized access to their child's grades if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Data Misuse by Parent
description: Once the grades and feedback are displayed to the parent, there is a risk that the parent may misuse this information, such as using it against the child or sharing it with unauthorized parties.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The data flow containing grades and feedback may be intercepted during transmission, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Unintended Disclosure of Information
description: The parent may unintentionally disclose sensitive information about the child to others, either verbally or through social media.

title: Unauthorized Access to Administrator Account
description: An unauthorized individual may gain access to the administrator account, allowing them to create, modify, or disable accounts and parent-child links without proper authorization.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive information (names, emails, roles, relationships) insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted between the School Administrator and the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Grades Portal Web App may improperly handle sensitive data, such as failing to anonymize or encrypt data before processing, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Account Records
description: The grading service may inadvertently expose account records to unauthorized users during the writing process, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Insecure Storage of Account Records
description: The account directory may not implement adequate security measures, leading to unauthorized access or data leaks of sensitive account information.

title: Data Leakage During Transfer
description: Data in transit between the grading service and the account directory may be intercepted, leading to exposure of sensitive information such as account details and parent-child relationships.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The assignment and grading service may inadvertently share sensitive student data with the cloud hosting provider without proper consent or authorization.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: During the nightly database backup, sensitive data such as grades and assignments may be intercepted while being transmitted to the cloud hosting provider.

title: Inadequate Data Protection by Third Party
description: The cloud hosting provider may not implement adequate security measures to protect the stored grade records and assignments, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The cloud hosting provider may retain the data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grade Records
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grade records stored in the database, leading to potential misuse of sensitive student information.

title: Inaccurate Data Representation
description: The assignment and grading service may misrepresent or incorrectly display grade records, leading to misinformation for students, parents, and teachers.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The grading service may retain grade records longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of grade records from the database to the grading service, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.
